home.heroText: Generous burgers, melty tacos and pizzas made to order. Benny's is waiting for you in the heart of Bouira, with recipes that put you in a good mood.
home.bestSellersText: The dishes everyone keeps coming back for. Tried, approved and often sold out.
home.categoriesText: From the classic burger to the family meal, there's something for every appetite.
home.why1Text: Ingredients picked every morning and fries cut in-house.
home.why2Text: Nothing sits under a lamp. We cook when you order.
home.why3Text: Straight to your neighbourhood in Bouira, hot and well packed.
home.storyTitle: A family story and good food
home.storyText1: Benny's started with a simple idea: serve Bouira the kind of fast food we truly love — generous, fresh and no fuss. One counter, a passionate team and recipes tested to the very last bite.
home.storyText2: Today we still make everything on site, with a smile and that little extra touch. Whether you visit us or order at home, we treat you like family.
home.hoursNote: Kitchen open until 30 minutes before closing.
home.locationText: We're in the heart of Bouira, close to everything. Grab a takeaway or sit down and eat in.
home.contactText: An allergy, a big order or just want to say hi? Message us on WhatsApp, we reply fast.
home.orderText: Add your favourite dishes to the cart and send your order in two clicks on WhatsApp.

about.title: What is Benny's?
about.subtitle: A neighbourhood fast food in Bouira, eager to do things right and make you leave with a smile.
about.storyText1: Benny's opened with one mission: make fast food as generous as it is friendly. Simple recipes, fresh ingredients and a team that knows its customers by name.
about.storyText2: Every burger is assembled to order, every sauce is made in-house and every delivery leaves with a little note. Taste matters, but so does the experience.
about.value1Text: We prefer a shorter menu and impeccable ingredients rather than the opposite.
about.value2Text: An order is a little moment of happiness. We take it seriously.
about.value3Text: We're proud to serve our city and keep the neighbourhood alive.
about.contactText: A question about the menu, an event to plan or a special delivery? We're reachable every day.
about.followText: News, offers and behind the scenes on our socials.
about.faq1A: Yes, we deliver to several areas in Bouira. Delivery is free from {amount}.
about.faq2A: Cash on delivery or on site at pickup. No online payment for now.
about.faq3A: Of course: size, sauces, extras and ingredients to remove can all be set on each dish page.

footer.tagline: Taste that makes you happy, in the heart of Bouira.
